verdict.rationale: Filee is MIT open-source desktop software that runs entirely on the user's own machine, works offline with nothing uploaded, ships a portable ZIP and silent installer, and can be built from source with the .NET 10 SDK, so the whole core product runs under the user's control. missing for 10: any server or multi-user deployment guidance (it is a local desktop app only), independent hands-on corroboration of building and running from source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Filee is a free, open-source (MIT) file converter for Windows 10 and 11 and Linux (macOS preview).
Build with the .NET 10 SDK on Windows, macOS or Linux
Nothing is uploaded. Filee works offline, so private documents, photos and recordings never leave your computer.
If you can't install programs, use the portable ZIP: unzip it anywhere and run Filee.exe.
